notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]4/17/2017
notes.content:
Patch V1.0.0.3 was released today.

PATCH NOTES
[list]
     [*][b]999:[/b] Issue where save data cannot be loaded in certain locations is now fixed.
     [*][b]999:[/b] Fixed issue where game would crash if PC was unable to play a movie file.
     [*][b]999/VLR:[/b] Fixed issue where game would crash if game data failed to save. 
     [*][b]999/VLR:[/b] Improved stability.   
[/list]
